courses.title: FAM&CS50 - Sanitation And Safety
courses.description: Students learn basic principles of sanitation and safety, including the types of microorganisms that cause foodborne illness, foodborne infections, toxin-mediated infections, and intoxications. Class includes a discussion of environmental conditions, including food hazards, contamination, cross-contamination, time and temperature, and personal food handler practices that cause sanitation/safety risks.
